biology.human-reproduction-explain.0001.all: villi give large surface area; thin walls / short diffusion distance; good blood supply in both maternal and fetal blood maintains concentration gradient

biology.human-reproduction-explain-multi.b: progesterone levels remain high (placenta/corpus luteum); uterus lining maintained so not shed
